page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying on external network storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is more varied; Geekbench multi-core and image processing scores rank in the top 25%, while stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation benchmarks fall into the middle 50%. Cryptographic capabilities are strong, as evidenced by a top 25% PassMark CPU encryption score, supported by hardware-level AES and SHA instruction sets. Memory performance is also robust, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top 25%, though raw memory read and write bandwidths remain in the middle 50%.

From a resource-density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation with one thread per physical core ensures predictable execution times without noisy-neighbor issues from hyperthreading, though it limits the overall vCPU density per dollar compared to shared-core or SMT-enabled alternatives. The complete absence of local storage requires users to provision external block storage, introducing a dependency on network-attached storage performance.

This server is configured for general-purpose workloads, database operations, text processing, image processing, and static web serving. Its balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio and strong single-core performance make it suitable for applications requiring consistent CPU execution and moderate memory capacity.
